items.description: — Max Johnson threw for 281 yards, three Eagles scored rushing touchdowns, and Georgia Southern cruised past FCS member Charleston Southern 31-0 on Saturday night.

items.headline: Max Johnson to start at quarterback for Georgia Southern
items.description: Georgia Southern has named veteran quarterback Max Johnson as the Eagles' starter. He previously was the starter at LSU, Texas A&M and North Carolina.
